name: Plant Climate Monitor
author: buildwithnoknok
description: Is the spot good for your plant? An Adafruit VEML7700 light sensor and a SparkFun TMP102 temperature sensor next to a noknok Display and LED Button. The display says Happy, Too dark, Too hot ...; the button LED is the plant's mood. Third-party Qwiic / Stemma QT boards: plug them in with the brain off.
assembly_guide: Unplug the PicoHub first: third-party boards are connected with the brain off.

Connect the Display, the LED Button, the Adafruit VEML7700 and the SparkFun TMP102 to the PicoHub. If the app warns about the I2C pull-ups, put the TMP102 on the second port or cut its pull-up jumper.
Put the sensors where the plant stands. Plug in the PicoHub and run setup in the noknok app, then pick your plant.

controls.action: Next page: Now / Temperature range / Good light hours
Green = happy, amber = light problem, blue = too cold, red = too hot, off at night
The display dims when the room is dark (switch off in the app)

controls.control: Hold a button or the knob while plugging in
controls.action: Factory reset - keep holding until the LEDs flash / the buzzer confirms (about 8 s)
